dea:capability-analytics-and-intelligenc.name: Analytics and Intelligence
dea:capability-analytics-and-intelligenc.definition: The ability to derive decision-grade insight from information the enterprise stewards or acquires.
dea:capability-analytics-and-intelligenc.outcome: Decisions are informed by derived intelligence.

evidence.rationale: E3; boundary settled by boundary-decision-cand-018 v0.1 (PR #29); evidence trail in docs/research (evidence-register, enterprise-generality-matrix, distinctness-sweep, admission-gate-closeout, boundary-decision-cand-018, admission-review-supplementary v0.2).

ladder_passage.actor: Coder (for eaojnr), normalization register + distinctness sweep (PRs #8, #12; N-003/N-009)
Coder (for eaojnr), placement decided at the supplementary review gate (PR #31; R-008)
Coder (for eaojnr), supplementary admission review v0.2 (PR #31; R-008)

dea:capability-analytics-and-intelligenc.why_capability: E3; the object and outcome tests carry the decision (Insight is a produced thing with its own lifecycle; decisions informed is an outcome distinct from information stewarded); vendor-heavy support noted and not load-bearing (boundary decision v0.1).
dea:capability-analytics-and-intelligenc.ecf_rationale: R-008: operations-enablement x operate; the span of analytics across domains is a property of the Insight object (R-003 parity), so secondaries stay empty per honest-not-exhaustive.
dea:capability-analytics-and-intelligenc.boundary: Derives insight; does not steward information (Information Management). Stewardship ends where derivation begins (boundary decision v0.1).
dea:capability-analytics-and-intelligenc.specialization_boundary: Sector analytics (clinical, actuarial, fraud) are specialization; the ability to derive insight is not.

dea:capability-asset-management.name: Asset Management
dea:capability-asset-management.definition: The ability to steward the enterprise's non-financial, non-workforce assets across their lifecycle.
dea:capability-asset-management.outcome: Assets are known, maintained, utilized, and retired deliberately.

evidence.rationale: Enterprise-generality demonstrated at E3; evidence trail in docs/research (evidence-register, enterprise-generality-matrix, distinctness-sweep, admission-gate-closeout).

ladder_passage.actor: Coder (for eaojnr), normalization register + distinctness sweep (PRs #8, #12)

dea:capability-asset-management.why_capability: E3; parent of Facility Management per the sweep (facilities are the asset class large enough to warrant its own first-order capability).
dea:capability-asset-management.ecf_rationale: Primary build in strategy-direction; operated and retired across the asset lifecycle.
dea:capability-asset-management.boundary: Stewards assets; does not manage money (Financial Management), technology as an estate (Technology Management), or facilities specifically (Facility Management).
dea:capability-asset-management.specialization_boundary: Asset classes (fleet, plant, spectrum rights) are specialization; the ability to steward assets is not.

dea:capability-change-management.name: Change Management

dea:capability-change-management.outcome: Change is initiated, sequenced, landed, and its effects verified, rather than merely happening.

evidence.rationale: Enterprise-generality demonstrated at E3; evidence trail in docs/research (evidence-register, enterprise-generality-matrix, distinctness-sweep, admission-gate-closeout).

ladder_passage.actor: Coder (for eaojnr), normalization register + distinctness sweep (PRs #8, #12)

dea:capability-change-management.why_capability: E3; stage-anchored at improve; cross-domain applicability resolved at review (R-005) as an object property, not a mapping defect.
dea:capability-change-management.ecf_rationale: R-005: primary governance-existence x improve (the ability is first exercised when the enterprise deliberately improves itself); secondaries empty per honest-not-exhaustive.
dea:capability-change-management.boundary: Manages change; does not set direction (Strategy), govern the enterprise (Enterprise Governance), or operate steady-state delivery (Operations).
dea:capability-change-management.specialization_boundary: Change kinds (organizational, technology, regulatory response) are specialization; the ability to change is not.

dea:capability-innovation-management.specialization_boundary: Innovation kinds (product, process, business model) and sector programs are specialization; the ability to innovate is not.

dea:capability-resilience-management.why_capability: E4; the continuity business object and the boundary against Risk and Security are drawn by ISO 22301, not by assertion; BCI GPG 7.0 carries an explicit all-sector applicability claim.
dea:capability-resilience-management.ecf_rationale: Primary governance-existence x design (continuity posture is designed into the enterprise); operated continuously through disruption response.
dea:capability-resilience-management.boundary: Manages continuity of delivery through disruption; does not treat uncertainty (Risk Management) or apply protective control (Security Management).
dea:capability-resilience-management.specialization_boundary: Sector continuity regimes (financial operational resilience under DORA, clinical service continuity) are specialization; the ability to continue delivery is not.

evidence.rationale: Enterprise-generality demonstrated at E4; evidence trail in docs/research (evidence-register, enterprise-generality-matrix, distinctness-sweep, admission-gate-closeout).

dea:capability-risk-management.why_capability: E4; parent of the governance triad relationship set (Compliance, Legal, Security relate through it) per the sweep.
dea:capability-risk-management.ecf_rationale: Primary conceive in governance-existence (risk posture is constituted with direction); operated and improved continuously.
dea:capability-risk-management.boundary: Manages exposure; does not manage obligation conformance (Compliance), legal matters (Legal), or protective control (Security).
dea:capability-risk-management.specialization_boundary: Risk classes (credit, operational, safety, cyber) are specialization; the ability to manage risk is not.

dea:capability-strategic-planning.outcome: A maintained plan that operationalizes strategy into choices the enterprise can govern and fund.

evidence.rationale: Enterprise-generality demonstrated at E3; evidence trail in docs/research (evidence-register, enterprise-generality-matrix, distinctness-sweep, admission-gate-closeout).

dea:capability-strategic-planning.why_capability: Distinct from Strategy (the sweep demonstrated partition: Strategy sets direction, Strategic Planning sequences its pursuit); recorded in every strategy-bearing corpus source.
dea:capability-strategic-planning.ecf_rationale: Planning begins at conceive in governance-existence, immediately downstream of Strategy.
dea:capability-strategic-planning.boundary: Plans the pursuit of direction; does not set direction (Strategy) or manage the resulting change portfolio (Change Management).
non_examples: A project plan (a process artifact, not this ability)
dea:capability-strategic-planning.specialization_boundary: Planning cadences and frameworks (rolling, scenario, Hoshin) are implementation choices, not specializations of the ability.

dea:capability-strategy.name: Strategy
dea:capability-strategy.definition: The ability to set the enterprise's direction: where it will compete, what it will become, and what it will not do.
dea:capability-strategy.outcome: An explicit, current statement of enterprise direction that constrains and guides every other capability.

evidence.rationale: Enterprise-generality demonstrated at E3; evidence trail in docs/research (evidence-register, enterprise-generality-matrix, distinctness-sweep, admission-gate-closeout).

ladder_passage.actor: Coder (for eaojnr), normalization register + distinctness sweep (PRs #8, #12)

dea:capability-strategy.why_capability: Direction-setting is exercised by every enterprise regardless of industry or implementation, is identifiable by its outcome, and passes the anti-invention test: every corpus source carries it.
dea:capability-strategy.ecf_rationale: Earliest initiation is conceive in governance-existence: strategy exists from the moment the enterprise is conceived; it is exercised again at improve.
dea:capability-strategy.boundary: Sets direction; does not plan its pursuit (Strategic Planning), govern its execution (Enterprise Governance), or deliver value (Operations).
non_examples: A strategic plan document (an artifact of Strategic Planning)
A board decision (an act of Enterprise Governance)
dea:capability-strategy.specialization_boundary: What is being strategized (a product line, a nation, a network) is specialization; the ability to strategize is not.
